description: Defines the UnmappedOutboundSignal class which models an outbound signal before mapping to an ExternalMessage, including JSON serialization/deserialization, and references to various JSON and connectivity components.

classes.name: UnmappedOutboundSignal
classes.description: Represents an outbound signal before it was mapped to an ExternalMessage, with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an UnmappedOutboundSignal instance from a JSON object, parsing source signal and targets using provided mapping strategies.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source Signal of the outbound signal.

methods.name: getTargets
methods.description: Returns the list of target destinations for the signal.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the UnmappedOutboundSignal to a JSON object according to schema version and predicate.
